title: Provider fix: Agent全体を低権限モードで起動する選択肢（--restricted）が追加された
summary: Claude Code v2.1.248 added --restricted / CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1, which removes the built-in tools that run commands or code plus WebFetch, restricts file access to the working directory, refuses bypassPermissions, and ignores user, project and local settings. Codex added client notification when Guardian requires strict review. This shifts the answer to over-broad agent authority from per-rule narrowing toward a whole-session capability floor, and notably closes the settings-file escalation path because --restricted ignores settings entirely - which also makes it a workaround-obsoleting change for teams that previously wrapped agents in external sandboxes just to strip execution tools.

evidence.summary: 'Notify clients when Guardian requires strict review' - equivalent move toward session-level escalation of review requirements.

notes: Not a new problem - it is a provider-side mitigation for I03 (excessive shell/GitHub/cloud/DB/production authority). Recorded as an update so the catalog's recommended response for I03 can cite a first-party low-privilege mode instead of only external sandboxing.
